affected_hardware: CUDA GPUs using FlashInfer FP8 KV cache
affected_kernel: FlashInfer attention backend FP8 KV scale handling
evidence_snippet: "Using FlashInfer with FP8 model with FP8 KV cache produces an error"; PR removes the k_scale/v_scale assertion.
rationale: A user-reported FP8 KV-cache model failed through FlashInfer. The fix changes backend scale plumbing and adds a cache test.
counterfactual_rationale: Requires serving a model whose quantization metadata carries k_scale/v_scale through FlashInfer.

introducing_evidence: "#18596 introduced the use of AITER MHA" and a breaking AITER enum.
evidence_snippet: "AITER commit ... has introduced a new enum value in a breaking changes manner."
rationale: The PR patches vLLM for a breaking AITER enum/API change so the ROCm AITER kernel path can run.
counterfactual_rationale: Running the ROCm AITER path with the updated AITER commit would likely expose the version breakage.

affected_kernel: DSA indexer fused Q/K prepare-and-store CUDA graph path
evidence_snippet: "profiler shows ~22 CUDA streams ... instead of the expected 2" from CUDA-graph capture ordering.
rationale: Kernel launch ordering in the fused DSA indexer made CUDA graph capture reserve one side stream per layer; the fix restores the two-stream graph.
counterfactual_rationale: Visible only in the DSA speculative decode CUDA-graph/serving scheduling path.

affected_kernel: SGLang FA4 QV varlen decode wrapper
evidence_snippet: "pack_gqa=False QV varlen decode path is incorrect for bs>1" and can read another sequence's paged KV.
rationale: The FA4 wrapper mishandled multi-sequence QV MLA decode and head-ratio tiling. The fix pads/crops groups and adds FA4 QV coverage.
counterfactual_rationale: A FA4 varlen reference test over bs>1 and non-tile-compatible Q/QV-to-KV head ratios on Blackwell would expose it.

evidence_snippet: "llama4 applies the topk weight before MoE calculation ... revise the current CPU path".
rationale: The CPU MoE path applied Llama4 router weights at the wrong point relative to the reference model, changing the MoE computation.
counterfactual_rationale: A Llama4-specific CPU MoE correctness test is needed; generic MoE tests for other models could miss the rule.

affected_kernel: DSA MLA fp8 trtllm prefill CP KV gather and RoPE quantization
evidence_snippet: "Fix a shape mismatch crash" with fp8 KV cache and trtllm; `k_rope_in.size(0) == nnz`.
rationale: The DSA CP path gathered KV before deferred fp8 trtllm RoPE quantization, mixing global and local shard dimensions.
counterfactual_rationale: Requires the full DSA prefill+CP+fp8 trtllm serving configuration on sm100 hardware.

affected_kernel: vLLM fused MoE backend selection for non-gated activations
evidence_snippet: "Previously, this was blocked on ROCm"; fix falls back to Triton for non-gated MoE.
rationale: ROCm MoE dispatch rejected non-gated activations and could select unsupported AITER; the fix enables ROCm and routes to Triton.
counterfactual_rationale: A ROCm test serving a non-gated MoE model such as NemotronH would exercise the unsupported dispatch.

evidence_snippet: "kernel produces incorrect results for test input `(8, 128, 128 * 33, fp8_dtype)`".
rationale: The FP8 activation kernel had a hidden-size/warp divisibility edge and reference-scale mismatch; the fix falls back to one warp for the bad geometry.
counterfactual_rationale: Kernel-vs-reference tests sweeping hidden sizes that do not divide evenly across selected warps would expose it.

affected_kernel: fused inplace qk-norm-rope path for Qwen-Image diffusion
evidence_snippet: "With `torch.compile` enabled ... every qwen-image request fails with HTTP 500" due to SymInt tracing.
rationale: The fused qk-norm-rope helper was forced through Dynamo with symbolic dimensions it could not constant-fold; compile now uses the unfused path.
counterfactual_rationale: A torch.compile Qwen-Image serving smoke test would trigger this integration failure.

evidence_snippet: "triton_kernels from triton 3.6 have GFX950MXScaleLayout changed to CDNA4MXScaleLayout".
rationale: A ROCm/Triton layout rename broke the GPT-OSS MXFP4 import path; the fix adds compatibility fallback imports.
counterfactual_rationale: CI covering the ROCm Triton 3.6 package combination would fail on import.

evidence_snippet: "Fix crash when loading llama4 model with old aiter version installed" and fallback to native.
rationale: The ROCm sampler import assumed a newer AITER op and crashed during startup; the fix catches import failure and uses native sampling.
counterfactual_rationale: A ROCm dependency-matrix startup test with the older AITER package would expose the missing op.

evidence_snippet: "Can build FA3 with CUDA version < 12.0" due to CUDA-12-only instruction/cc 9.0a; disable FA3 for 11.8.
rationale: FA3 used instructions/build settings unsupported by CUDA 11.8; the fix disables FA3 in that configuration and adjusts tests.
counterfactual_rationale: A CUDA 11.8 build/test lane compiling FA3 would fail before merge.

affected_kernel: vLLM CPU fused MoE activation dispatch
evidence_snippet: "AssertionError: Current vLLM config is not set" when `_CPU_MOE_ACT` instantiates CustomOp classes.
rationale: The CPU fused MoE path lazily instantiated CustomOp activation classes during forward, requiring unavailable vLLM config; it now uses native functions.
counterfactual_rationale: A CPU MoE forward/serving test in the reported configuration would trigger the config assertion.

affected_hardware: NVIDIA CUDA with FA3 EAGLE speculative decoding
affected_kernel: FlashAttention multi-step EAGLE draft-decode expand metadata
evidence_snippet: "scatter_ writes out of bounds" and later surfaces as illegal memory access / NaN logits.
rationale: The page_size>1 draft-decode metadata scattered too-wide cache locations into a narrow page table for topk>1.
counterfactual_rationale: Memcheck on the topk>1/page_size>1 repro would likely flag the out-of-bounds scatter.

affected_hardware: CUDA GPUs running GGUF dequantize kernels
evidence_snippet: "int64_t product m * n is silently truncated to int" leaving stale GPU memory unfilled.
rationale: The GGUF kernel ABI truncated large element counts, leaving output tensors partly uninitialized; the fix widens counts and zero-fills outputs.
counterfactual_rationale: Initcheck/memcheck on a large-dimension dequantize call could flag uninitialized output; huge edge tests also help.

affected_kernel: ROCm branch of vLLM CUDA memory allocator
evidence_snippet: "VRAM remains occupied at the hardware level" after sleep, preventing other applications from using memory.
rationale: The ROCm allocator did not actually free physical VRAM during sleep mode; cycling address reservation forces driver release.
counterfactual_rationale: A ROCm sleep/wake hardware test checking rocm-smi or mem_get_info would expose it.

affected_kernel: SGLang fused MoE Triton/fp8 AITER compile path
rationale: The ROCm/AITER DeepSeek V3 test failed under torch.compile in the MoE/fp8 kernel path; the fix updates that integration/dependency.
counterfactual_rationale: A reliable pre-merge ROCm torch.compile lane would have caught it.

affected_kernel: DeepSeek V4 HIP radix attention DSPARK graph metadata
evidence_snippet: "DSPARK's draft KV-store path consumes swa_loc" so replays can write KV to stale ring locations.
rationale: Captured graph metadata rebound a Python reference instead of updating the captured buffer, so DSPARK draft KV writes used stale locations.
counterfactual_rationale: The stale captured-buffer bug manifests in DSPARK graph replay and accept-length/serving accuracy.
